text: A menu driven C++ application for streetlight records and repair requests

Streetlight Repair Desk manages reports from the moment a fault is registered until repair completion.
A city or campus needs a clear way to store streetlight records, receive faults, and track repair work.
Register, update, delete, search, and display streetlights
Receive repair requests in arrival order
Process repairs and undo the latest completed repair
Show BST traversals and a priority-sorted report
The application uses manual data-structure implementations. It does not use ready-made stack, queue, list, map, or tree classes.
Each required structure has an actual role in the same integrated application.
Big O analysis and manual test cases
README, report, screenshots, and shared repository

The project keeps only the fields required for the repair workflow.
poleId, location, zone, condition, isWorking, priority
Pole ID is unique because the BST uses it as the search key.
A singly linked list stores the actual streetlight records.

head points to the first node
count stores the current size
remove: deletes a node by Pole ID
search: returns a pointer to matching data
Why this structure fits: the inventory changes over time and each record uses dynamic node allocation.
The BST gives a direct index for each unique Pole ID.

key: Pole ID
light: Streetlight*
left and right child pointers
The node points to the linked-list record instead of copying it.
insert: rejects a duplicate Pole ID
search: follows left or right branches
remove: handles leaf, one-child, and two-child nodes
inorder: prints Pole IDs in ascending order
A circular array queue processes fault reports in arrival order.
Circular indexes reuse array positions after dequeue operations.
enqueue: adds a new fault report at the rear
dequeue: removes the first waiting report
front: previews the next report without removing it
isEmpty, isFull, and size: handle queue state
The Stack stores completed repairs and enables Undo for the latest repair.
push: saves the state before marking a repair as completed
pop: removes the latest action and restores the old state
peek: previews the latest action without removing it
isEmpty, isFull, and size: prevent invalid actions
Undo restores the streetlight condition and working state. It does not put the request back in the Queue.
The sort creates a report without changing the linked list or BST.
